body:
alisha: Quick FYI — we're planning to retire trace.attr.environment and consolidate on trace.attr.env. RFC here: https://r.rw/rfc/trace-env-migration :point_right: Need a concrete ingest->enrich->query migration plan and owners.

martin: +1. What's the compatibility story for late-enriched traces? will old key still be present for a transition window? :thinking:

alisha: Plan A is dual-writing at the gateway for 6 weeks, then a background job to backfill historical traces, then stop writing the old key. But dual-write increases payload size — need cost estimate.

chen: For enrichers: we can read either key and normalize to internal `env` field during enrichment. That keeps downstream consumers unchanged. Small change in enrichment-contracts.

yasmin: Dashboarding and alerting teams will need a release window. Most alerts assume `trace.attr.environment`. If we normalize at enrich time, alerts keep working and we can flip when backfill complete.

sam: Concern: cost attribution systems depend on exact attribute names for bucketing. If we dual-write, billing pipeline will see both and risk double-counting. We need a dedupe step or a canonicalization rule in the billing pre-agg.

ingest-bot: Deploy job queued: preflight-schema-check for trace attrs (job id: 2026-09-12-idx-77).

alisha: Good call, sam. Proposal: enrichment stage canonicalizes into `env` and attaches `meta.original_attr` = "trace.attr.environment" for lineage. Billing pre-agg should prefer canonicalized `env` and ignore the original if present. That avoids double counting.

martin: Implementation detail: add a small boolean `canonicalized_by=enrich-v2` and set in envelope so pre-agg can pick it deterministically.

chen: Backfill: I'll write a streaming job that reads raw traces, projects the old key -> new key, and writes compacted records to cold storage. It will run with a read rate cap to avoid egress spikes. Example transform snippet:```jq
.env = .attributes["trace.attr.environment"] // .attributes["trace.attr.env"]
.del .attributes["trace.attr.environment"]
```

yasmin: How long until dashboards show only `trace.attr.env`? We should schedule a canary: 2% of traffic with old key removed, validate dashboards and SLOs for 48h, then ramp.

sam: For billing dedupe, pre-agg should implement: prefer `canonicalized_by` tag, else pick `env` if present, else fallback to old. Adds a microsecond of processing but safe. Also need unit tests with synthetic traces showing both keys.

alisha: Ops checklist draft:
- gateway: dual-write switch + feature-flag (owner: alisha)
- enrichers: read-either + set `canonicalized_by` (owner: chen)
- billing pre-agg: prefer canonicalized, add dedupe tests (owner: sam)
- backfill job: streaming rewriter to cold store (owner: chen)
- dashboards/alerts: canary + validation (owner: yasmin)
- runbook: rollback steps if missing env after flip (owner: alisha)

martin: Timeline idea: feature-flag rollout over 2 weeks, 6 week dual-write, backfill running during dual-write, then deprecate old key. We should time with a slow weekend for minimal query load.

yasmin: Can we add a visibility metric for how many traces still have the old key? I'll add a per-hour gauge to the dashboard so we can track migration progress.

alisha: Yes — enrichment can emit `migration.trace_env_old_key_ratio` per shard. Use that to gate the cutoff (target < 0.1% over 48h).

sam: Also add a one-off job that scans the billing index to validate no double-counting after the dedupe rule is live. We should snapshot pre/dedupe totals for comparison.

chen: Security/PII check: make sure `meta.original_attr` doesn't accidentally expose anything sensitive. It's just the attribute name string, should be fine, but we'll add it to the schema allowlist.

alisha: OK — owners listed. I'll file a short RFC follow-up and a rollout board. Can everyone drop a quick ack + preferred start date? :rocket:

martin: ack. prefer to start next Thursday 09/21 (low traffic).

chen: ack. start next Thursday works for me.

yasmin: ack. I'll block dashboards and watch for the canary.

sam: ack. I'll draft the billing tests this week.

ingest-bot: CI: schema-check passed for current trunk (build 1128). :white_check_mark:

alisha: Thanks all — I'll post the short plan and owners doc in #eng-platform and link the rollout board. Will also add the visibility metric to the migration dashboard. :thumbsup:
